note: Frozen ground truth for S4. Defect identity is decided by executing a finding's reproduction against the shipped modules and comparing the result with the oracle for that (module, export). Wording is never matched.

defects.summary: Duplicate removal compares the raw tag before lowercasing, so tags that differ only in case survive as duplicates.
A multi-word query is treated as OR instead of AND, so notes matching only one term are returned.
A note due at exactly the current instant is reported overdue; the comparison is >= where the spec requires >.
Ties on updatedAt are broken by title descending instead of ascending.
Lines with fewer than three fields are skipped instead of defaulted, so title-only and title+body rows are silently lost on import.
totalPages uses Math.floor, so the final partial page is unreachable and its items are lost to the reader.

nonbugs.note: Slugs keep non-ASCII letters rather than transliterating them. Spec-conformant and deliberate.
A hyphenated compound counts as one word. Spec-conformant.
includeArchived: true shows archived AND unarchived notes; it is not an archived-only filter. Spec-conformant.
The last record with an id wins but keeps the first occurrence's position. Spec-conformant.
An empty body is valid; a title-only note is allowed. Spec-conformant.
